status_note: The measurement set for this notebook is being re-run on the Spark pair with two boots per arm, more arms, and paired per-workload statistics. Every value below is null until that lands. The preliminary block records what a single-boot session measured on 2026-09-08; it is superseded on landing and must not be quoted as the result.

protocol.fixture: eval100 — 100 held-out prompts, 33 code / 33 math / 34 chat, stratified from the training corpus held-out split, frozen and identical for every arm

metric_definitions.aggregate_tok_s: sum of completion tokens over all requests / sum of wall time over all requests, counted from the final usage object
metric_definitions.median_tok_s: median of per-request tok/s across the 100 prompts
metric_definitions.accepted_length: engine acceptance counters: accepted draft tokens per engine pass, including the bonus token
metric_definitions.ms_per_engine_pass: group wall time / spec draft passes; includes sampling, scheduler and IPC. Never comparable with a target-forward-only figure.

protocol.analysis: paired stratified bootstrap over prompts (4000 resamples), averaging repeats within a prompt before differencing, stratified by workload; reported as a percentage difference in aggregate throughput with a conditional 95% CI. Pooled medians are NOT a paired difference test and were the source of an earlier wrong 'indistinguishable from zero' reading.

planned_extras: per-workload (code / math / chat) medians and paired bootstrap CIs for every arm above
a graph-mode vs eager A/B on one arm, if graph capture fits under the 0.75 unified-memory policy at all
